meta.title: GeoGebra Studio
meta.description: Adds a GeoGebra Studio entry to the left sidebar. Selecting it opens a live, editable GeoGebra canvas in the right sidebar while the conversation stays open; geogebra_build renders the figure into that canvas, and the geogebra_preview and geogebra_export tools remain available for standalone links and source export. Rendering loads the official GeoGebra engine and needs network access. The plugin writes only new files in the workspace.
